query:
UPDATE import_rows
        SET category_id = $3,
            issues = COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(e) FROM jsonb_array_elements(issues) e
                 WHERE e->>'field' <> 'category_text'),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
        WHERE batch_id = $1 AND lower(trim(category_text)) = lower(trim($2))
